text: Build a hypothesis-driven strategic planning engine
description: Turn the aim graph into an engine that can generate, compare, execute, and revise complex hypotheses and action plans over long horizons. This should make Aimparency more than a task tracker: it should become a strategic cortex for autonomous systems.

status.comment: Cancelled 24 July 2026 as an over-abstract subsystem. Aims already represent hypotheses or strategies; contribution edges and explanations represent how they help, including alternatives/fallbacks; statuses and reflections carry execution evidence and learning. Do not add a separate strategic-planning engine unless a real workflow proves a missing primitive.
